=== azure-pipelines.yml (tasks-pipelines)
# Imported from azure-pipelines.yml by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: ci
on:
  push: {branches: [main, releases/*], tags: [v*], paths: [src/*]}
  pull_request: {into: [main]}
  schedule:
    - {cron: 0 3 * * *}
inputs:
  target: {type: choice, options: [dev, prod], default: dev}
  verbose: {type: boolean, default: false}
defaults:
  env: {buildConfig: Release}
containers:
  build-compile: {image: 'node:20'}
  build-compile-db:
    image: postgres:16
    service: true
    env: {POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test}
steps:
  build-compile:
    container: build-compile
    timeout: 30m
    on_failure: continue
    env:
      GOMODCACHE: .cache/go-mod
    secrets:
      NPM_TOKEN: {store: vault, key: NPM_TOKEN, field: value}
    run: |
      # Build
      (
        cd web
        export CI=true
        npm ci
        npm run build -- --config ${buildConfig} --rev $LAUNCHWAY_COMMIT --token ${NPM_TOKEN} --x ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET} ${{ variables.other }}
      )
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: a PowerShell step ran here'; exit 1
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: the task SomeVendorTask@1 ran here'; exit 1
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: a template of steps was included here'; exit 1
      echo cond
    cache:
      - {name: cache-go-mod, paths: [.cache/go-mod], key: {files: [go.sum]}}
    reports:
      tests: ['**/junit.xml']
      coverage: [coverage/cobertura.xml]
    artifacts:
      - {name: dist, paths: [web/dist]}
  build-matrix:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: build-compile
    secrets:
      image: {store: vault, key: image, field: value}
    run: |
      echo ${image}
  test-unit:
    image: docker.io/library/python:3.12
    needs: [build-compile, build-matrix]
    run: |
      pytest
    fetch:
      - {from: build-compile, name: dist}
  test-report:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: test-unit
    when: {upstream: always}
    run: |
      echo report
  deploy-prod:
    kind: image
    push: true
    tags:
      - {repository: team/shop, tag: {run: sha}}
      - {repository: team/shop, tag: latest}
    needs: [test-unit, test-report]
  deploy-gate:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: [test-unit, test-report]
    when: {branch: main}
    run: |
      echo ok
